reason: I've already got two clients I think are getting more than they pay for, and a free audit with a DPA and the ticket evidence attached costs me 45 minutes. If it turns up a few grand a year I'd accept, £99 a month is an easy sum for my finance person to sign off.
objection: Most of what it flags will be free work we give on purpose to keep clients, and after the first audit has picked up the obvious stuff I doubt the monthly checks keep finding £99 worth. I'm also wary of handing a full PSA export to a one-person outfit I've never heard of.
would_change_my_mind: If the free audit only tells me what I already know about those two clients and nothing new, I wouldn't carry on with the monthly subscription.
